text.text_excerpt: I was reminded today to give a shout-out to Becky and the folks from The Curious Oyster Co. for being a part of a perfect 30th birthday. The fam and I had been in the St. Claude area picking up plants and looking at the antique stores around those parts, and I had been wanting to try out the St. Roch Market since it had opened the previous weekend. Parking was a cinch next door. The space inside is really beautiful. It doesn't really look like anything else in New Orleans. Lots of lights, marble, fresh flowers in little jars, and a good bit of people chillin', shoppin', and generally just enjoying the space. My sister and her boyfriend had been a day or two before and talked up The Curiou...

I know the place is provably awesome, but prestidigitation occurred and it vanished into your new location. I went to this place that had nobody there with a sign saying "ring bell-making new food in back" so I bothered the girl and got the shrimp and grits and a muffuletta panini. (It's hard to mess those up...." But it attracted lots of business because many that go there are tourists. And when they see a guy in an ANSI Grade2 traffic uniform it was like "what is this, what is that......" As a driving ambassador I am compelled to answer, as my actual job is a psychologist for people on the verge of a panic attack when their car breaks down. Which for me is 20x a day.

I can't believe how often I came to St. Roch Market, how many things I tried, how close I was staying- and I still managed not to try their oysters. I did have their blueberry lemonade though and it was off the charts! The essence of refreshing.
